ctx.x: Well, that's terrific. I hope we can have a copy of that made as well.

Yes. The kick-off for the House that Jazz Built that was held in 1975 at the Biltmore Hotel at one of Wilma Dobic's Overseas Press Club jazz parties and on that tape you'll see me playing my pocket trumpet.

Lovely. Lovely, yeah. Anyway, what I was leading up to is on that interview with McMillan you do spend a good half of it talking about your days in Pittsburgh so that is something that we'll hopefully implement to what we're going to talk about here today. Can we start out by asking you about your family and how far back you can trace your roots and your geneology and so on?
